name: London Luton Airport

runway.quote: Work on the 2.16km runway commenced each night at 00:01 and completed by 05:45

hours.quote: LLA holds a 24 hour licence to operate and there is no ban on night flights.

curfew.v: no night ban (24-hour licence), but a night quota period 23:30-06:00 local time with movement limits and quota counts; older-generation jets are not allowed at night
curfew.quote: Night Quota Period: 2330 – 0600 local time. Departures 2315 – 0545 local time (inclusive) Arrivals 2330 – 0600 local time (inclusive)

noise.v: night flights are controlled through lower noise violation limits, movement limits and a quota count system
noise.quote: Each specific aircraft type is assigned Quota points based on how noisy it is.

slots.v: a fully coordinated (Level 3) airport, so slots are allocated by the UK slot coordinator (ACL)
slots.context: Listed by ACL among UK Level 3 (coordinated) airports; ACL Luton page: 'London Luton Airport was formally declared as Level 3 effective Summer 2013.'

handling.v: business aviation handled by Signature Flight Support (two sites) and Harrods Aviation
handling.quote: Harrods Aviation is the leading London-based business aviation service provider.

ppr.v: every fixed-wing flight needs Prior Permission to Operate (a PPO time) from the slot coordinator ACL, requested by the operator's authorised handling agent (or the operator's own ACL account); arriving flights must have it before leaving their origin; no fixed notice period, request as early as possible
ppr.quote: All fixed wing aircraft flights at London Luton Airport (LLAO) are required to secure Prior Permission to Operate.
